checks.summary: A chart's anchor corner lies in a hidden row or column.
A chart object is hidden and provides no visible evidence.
A chart reaches more than one printed page, so printing and PDF export split it.
A chart is narrower than 120 or shorter than 80 pixels.
A chart has no data series.
A worksheet's last row is the evaluation notice that a CSV or TSV export without a license wrote after the data.
A worksheet is the evaluation warning sheet that a save without a license added; a licensed re-save keeps it and the other evaluation marks.
A font the document uses is unavailable or substituted, so the rendering may differ from the author's.
A formula evaluates to an error value.
Columns that contain data are hidden.
Columns that contain data are narrower than 3 character units.
Columns that contain data are wider than 80 character units.
Rows that contain data are hidden.
Rows that contain data are shorter than 8 points.
Rows that contain data are taller than 120 points.
A print area is more than 20 times the bounds of the populated content.
A print area does not intersect a chart on its worksheet.
A print area does not contain every populated cell of its worksheet.
A saved print area cannot be interpreted as bounded A1 ranges.
The artifact limit stopped rendering before every visible worksheet had an image.
A visible worksheet has no cells or drawing objects, so its image is a blank placeholder.
A worksheet is hidden and therefore excluded from the visual evidence.
Text spills over empty cells and ends close to a column edge, where a sheet image can cut its last character.
Less than 1% of a worksheet's used area of at least 100 cells contains data.
Values are wider than their columns: text is cut off by the next cell, or a number cannot show in full (#### or rounded).
The workbook contains VBA, which static images do not exercise.

commands.name: cells
commands.description: Spreadsheet operations (Excel and friends) with engine-grade fidelity.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare stored workbook values and optional formula text; dates are ISO 8601.

options.name: --content
options.description: What to compare; formulas adds the formula text to the cell results.

options.name: --left-password
options.description: Password for the baseline file. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --left-password-env.

options.name: --left-password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the baseline file.

options.name: --left-password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the baseline file from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --max-diffs
options.description: Maximum differing cells to list across the entire workbook. Range: 1-1000000.

options.name: --right-password
options.description: Password for the candidate file. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --right-password-env.

options.name: --right-password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the candidate file.

options.name: --right-password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the candidate file from the first line of stdin.

arguments.name: right

commands.name: convert

options.name: --bom

options.name: --dry-run

options.name: --encoding
options.description: Text encoding of a CSV or TSV input, such as gb18030, big5, shift_jis or windows-1252. Default: its byte order mark, else UTF-8 (other bytes are refused).

options.name: --encrypt

options.name: --encrypt-env

options.name: --encrypt-stdin

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.description: Target format: xlsx, xltx, xlsm, xltm, xlsb, xls, ods, csv, tsv, html, mhtml, pdf, xps, json, md. Default: the --out extension's format.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --backup
options.description: Create a non-overwriting backup before an in-place write.

options.name: --best-effort
options.description: Keep successful operations, report failures, and exit 8.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the operations, and apply the operations in memory, without writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the edit succeeds.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output file. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --ops

options.name: --set
options.description: Set one cell as SHEET!CELL=VALUE; repeatable, applied after the --ops document. A VALUE starting with '=' is a formula; otherwise TRUE/FALSE and numbers are typed and anything else is text. Quote sheet names that need it: --set "'My Sheet'!A1=5". Example: --set "Sales!B3=42" --set "Sales!G2==E2*F2".

v2/cells/compare-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells compare: a structural comparison of two workbooks. A completed comparison succeeds (exit 0) even when the workbooks differ: the verdict is identical, not a failure, which lets a caller (or the eval harness) use compare as a verifier.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

identical.description: True when the two workbooks are equal within the compared scope.

sheets.description: Per-sheet differences; omitted when the workbooks are identical. The listed cells stop at the diff budget, which a LIST_TRUNCATED warning discloses.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

left.description: The left side; omitted when the cell is empty there.

right.description: The right side; omitted when the cell is empty there.

cellsCellSide.description: One side of a changed cell: its canonical stored value and optional formula. Dates are ISO 8601 strings; an absent empty side is omitted.

t.description: Stored type: empty, number, datetime, string, boolean or error.

v.description: Canonical stored value: a number, an ISO 8601 string for a date or time (local, without an offset, as a read reports it), a string, a boolean or an error literal; omitted for an empty cell. Two cells holding the same serial are equal whether or not one is formatted as a date.

f.description: Formula, when present and in scope.

cellsCompareSummary.description: Aggregate counts of a workbook comparison.

sheetsAdded.description: Sheets present only on the right.

sheetsRemoved.description: Sheets present only on the left.

sheetsRenamed.description: Sheets the right holds under a new name, paired with the left sheet by their internal sheet id.

cellsDiffering.description: Total differing cells across all shared and renamed sheets: the true count even when a LIST_TRUNCATED warning reports that --max-diffs capped the listed cells.

status.description: One of added, removed, modified or renamed: a sheet both sides hold under different names, paired by its internal id.

from.description: The sheet's name on the left, for a renamed sheet.

cells.description: Differing cells, for a modified or renamed sheet.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

sheets.description: The sheets the conversion was limited to, in workbook order, when --sheets selected some.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

sheets.description: Sheet names of a newly created workbook.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

v2/cells/edit-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells edit. Batches are atomic by default: the result exists only when every op applied (or on a dry run). With --best-effort the batch is partial — failing ops are recorded with status: failed and an error, the rest still apply, and the command exits 8. A resource failure of the invocation aborts publication. Verification describes the staged candidate and the evidence published with it.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

output.description: The produced file; omitted for dry runs.

checked.description: What the dry run checked, in a fixed order; omitted when the edit was written.

recalculated.description: true when formulas were recalculated before saving: a calculation runs after the complete batch unless --no-recalc is given, and this is true when it succeeded.

backup.description: Stable safety backup used for an in-place mutation, when requested.

verification.description: Present with --verify: the staged workbook compared cell by cell with the input, and scanned for formula errors.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

cellsCellError.description: A cell whose formula evaluates to an error — a delivery-time QA signal.

sheet.description: Sheet the cell is on.

preexisting.description: true in edit verification when the input cell had the same formula and the same error value; omitted otherwise.

cellsCellSide.description: One side of a changed cell: its canonical stored value and optional formula. Dates are ISO 8601 strings; an absent empty side is omitted.

t.description: Stored type: empty, number, datetime, string, boolean or error.

v.description: Canonical stored value: a number, an ISO 8601 string for a date or time (local, without an offset, as a read reports it), a string, a boolean or an error literal; omitted for an empty cell. Two cells holding the same serial are equal whether or not one is formatted as a date.

f.description: Formula, when present and in scope.

cellsEditVerification.description: Post-edit evidence produced by cells edit --verify.

ok.description: Whether the verification found no issue.

issues.description: The problems found, empty when ok is true.

checkedOps.description: In batch order, the ids of the operations whose effect the verification read back from the staged output; an operation left out was not checked.

requestedTargets.description: Targets requested by the operations in this invocation.

directChanges.description: Changes inside a requested operation target.

formulaResultChanges.description: Cells whose formula text stayed the same while the calculated result changed.

otherChanges.description: Changes that could not be reliably attributed to a requested target or formula recalculation.

formulaErrors.description: Formula errors found anywhere in the edited workbook.

truncated.description: true when the edit changed more than 1000 cells, so the change lists hold only the first 1000; the checks behind ok still cover every cell.

cellsVerificationOtherChange.description: A changed cell or worksheet that could not be classified as a direct or formula-result change.

sheet.description: Worksheet name.

status.description: Sheet status: added, removed, modified or renamed.

cell.description: A1 cell address for a cell-level change.

left.description: Cell before the edit; omitted when absent or sheet-level.

right.description: Cell after the edit; omitted when absent or sheet-level.

cellsVerificationTarget.description: An operation target included in post-edit verification.

sheet.description: Worksheet name; omitted when the operation addressed the active sheet implicitly.

range.description: A1 range; omitted for a whole-sheet target.

cellsVerifiedCellChange.description: Before-and-after values for one verified cell.

sheet.description: Worksheet name.

left.description: Cell before the edit; omitted when it was empty.

right.description: Cell after the edit; omitted when it is empty.

v2/cells/inspect-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells inspect: a compact structural summary designed as the first step of the projection ladder (metadata before structure, structure before values). Never contains full cell data.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

range.description: The range the AutoFilter covers, header row included.

cellsCellError.description: A cell whose formula evaluates to an error — a delivery-time QA signal.

sheet.description: Sheet the cell is on.

preexisting.description: true in edit verification when the input cell had the same formula and the same error value; omitted otherwise.

cellsChartAxisTitles.description: The axis titles of a chart; only the fields present are applied. Pie charts have no axes.

category.description: The title of the category (X) axis.

value.description: The title of the value (Y) axis.

cellsChartDataLabels.description: The data labels of a chart's series; only the fields present are applied.

visible.description: Whether each point's value shows next to it.

numberFormat.description: The number format code of the labels, such as #,##0.

sheet.description: Sheet the chart is on.

index.description: The 1-based index of the chart on its sheet, as set_chart and delete_chart take it.

kind.description: The chart kind: a insert_chart type such as column, or the lower-camel engine name of a type outside that vocabulary, such as columnStacked.

title.description: The chart title; omitted when the chart shows none or an automatic one.

dataRange.description: The range the series plot, headers included, such as A1:C5: the smallest range covering every series' values, categories and name. It names the sheet only when that is not the chart's own. Omitted when no series plots cells.

seriesInRows.description: Whether the series are plotted from rows rather than columns.

legend.description: The legend: whether it shows, and its position when it is one of the four sides.

axisTitles.description: The axis titles; omitted when the chart has no axes or no axis title.

seriesColors.description: The color of each series in series order; a pie's slices count as the series. Omitted when the chart has no series.

dataLabels.description: The data labels of the first series; omitted when the chart has no series.

cellsChartLegend.description: The legend of a chart; only the fields present are applied. There is no none position: hide the legend with visible false.

position.description: The side of the chart the legend sits on.

first.description: The first column of the group.

last.description: The last column of the group.

level.description: The outline level, 1 for the outermost group.

collapsed.description: true when every column of the group is hidden, as a collapsed group's columns are.

cellsColumnWidthInfo.description: A run of adjacent columns of one width.

first.description: The first column of the run.

last.description: The last column of the run.

widthChars.description: The width in characters of the default font's digit 0.

sheet.description: Sheet the comment is on.

author.description: The comment author; omitted when empty.

cellsConditionalFormatInfo.description: One conditional-formatting rule, one entry per rule in the order the sheet holds them.

sheet.description: Sheet the rule is on.

range.description: The A1 range the rule formats; several areas are comma-separated.

rule.description: The rule, in add_conditional_format's fields; a number reads without the leading = Excel stores.

matchStyle.description: The style matching cells receive; omitted for the kinds that take none.

cellsConditionalRuleInfo.description: A conditional-formatting rule as a read reports it: add_conditional_format's fields the rule's kind uses.

kind.description: The rule kind: an add_conditional_format kind such as cell-value, or the lower-kebab engine name of a kind outside that vocabulary, such as contains-text, whose other fields are not read.

operator.description: The comparison of a cell-value rule.

value1.description: The comparison value of a cell-value rule (the lower bound for between), or the formula of a formula rule.

value2.description: The upper bound of a between or not-between cell-value rule.

minColor.description: The low-end color of a color-scale.

midColor.description: The middle color of a 3-point color-scale.

maxColor.description: The high-end color of a color-scale.

barColor.description: The bar color of a data-bar.

rank.description: The N of a top-bottom rule.

percent.description: Whether a top-bottom rank is a percentage of the range.

fromBottom.description: Whether a top-bottom rule marks the bottom rather than the top.

iconSet.description: The icons of an icon-set rule: an add_conditional_format icon set, or the lower-kebab engine name of one outside that vocabulary.

cellsConditionalStyle.description: The differential style a conditional format gives matching cells. Excel applies only font emphasis, colors and the number format there; format_range sets fonts, sizes, alignment, wrapping and indents. It sets at least one field.

underline.description: Whether the text has a single underline.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

numberFormat.description: The number format code, such as 0.0%.

refersTo.description: What it refers to (a range or formula).

cell.description: The top-left cell of the scrolling pane: A2 freezes row 1, B2 row 1 and column A.

cellsHyperlinkInfo.description: A hyperlink, with one of url and target.

sheet.description: Sheet the hyperlink is on.

range.description: The A1 range the hyperlink covers.

url.description: The external address: a URL, an e-mail address or a file.

target.description: The internal target; it names the sheet only when that is not the hyperlink's own.

display.description: The text shown in the cell; omitted when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet the picture is on.

index.description: The 1-based index of the picture on its sheet.

cellsMargins.description: Page margins in points (72 per inch); only the sides present are applied, and at least one is set. A read reports every side.

cellsPageSetupInfo.description: A sheet's page setup for printing and PDF export.

orientation.description: The page orientation: portrait or landscape.

pageSize.description: The page size as the page is laid out: in landscape the width is the longer side, so it writes back unchanged with the orientation.

scalePercent.description: The zoom percentage; present when the printout does not fit to pages.

fitToWidth.description: The number of pages the printout fits across, 0 automatic; present when it fits to pages.

fitToHeight.description: The number of pages the printout fits down, 0 automatic; present when it fits to pages.

margins.description: The page margins in points, every side.

headerMargin.description: The distance in points from the top of the page to the header.

footerMargin.description: The distance in points from the bottom of the page to the footer.

headerCenter.description: The center header text, with Excel codes such as &P; omitted when empty.

headerLeft.description: The left header text; omitted when empty.

headerRight.description: The right header text; omitted when empty.

footerCenter.description: The center footer text, with Excel codes such as &P and &N; omitted when empty.

footerLeft.description: The left footer text; omitted when empty.

footerRight.description: The right footer text; omitted when empty.

cellsPivotInfo.description: A pivot table in a workbook.

sheet.description: Sheet the pivot table is on.

range.description: A1 range the pivot report covers.

sourceRange.description: The source data, headers included; it names the sheet only when that is not the pivot's own.

rows.description: The header names of the row fields; omitted when there are none.

columns.description: The header names of the column fields; omitted when there are none.

values.description: The value fields with their aggregation and caption; omitted when there are none.

captions.description: The caption language: zh when the headers carry Excel's Simplified Chinese captions, otherwise en.

cellsPivotValueInfo.description: One value field of a pivot table, in insert_pivot's fields.

field.description: The header name of the source column.

function.description: The aggregation: an insert_pivot function such as sum, or the lower-camel engine name of one outside that vocabulary, such as stdDev.

numberFormat.description: The number format code of the field; omitted when it has none.

label.description: The caption of the value field.

cellsPrintAreaInfo.description: A sheet's print area and the rows and columns repeated on every printed page.

range.description: The print area, such as A1:H50; several areas are comma-separated. Omitted when only titles are set.

titleRows.description: The rows repeated on every printed page, such as $1:$2.

titleColumns.description: The columns repeated on every printed page, such as $A:$B.

first.description: The first row of the group (1-based).

last.description: The last row of the group (1-based).

level.description: The outline level, 1 for the outermost group.

collapsed.description: true when every row of the group is hidden, as a collapsed group's rows are.

cellsRowHeightInfo.description: A run of adjacent rows of one height.

first.description: The first row of the run (1-based).

last.description: The last row of the run (1-based).

name.description: Sheet name, exactly as shown in Excel.

position.description: 1-based position in the tab order, as insert_sheet and move_sheet take it.

usedRange.description: A1 range covering all cells that hold data (e.g. A1:G120); omitted for empty sheets.

rowCount.description: Number of data rows inside usedRange.

columnCount.description: Number of data columns inside usedRange.

hidden.description: true when the sheet is hidden.

protected.description: true when the sheet is protected: Excel then lets users change only unlocked cells and the actions the protection allows. Edits are not held to it; see PROTECTION_NOT_ENFORCED.

passwordProtected.description: true when removing the sheet's protection needs a password.

chartCount.description: Number of charts on the sheet.

pivotTableCount.description: Number of pivot tables on the sheet.

preview.description: Optional sample of display values (first rows of the used range), present only when --sample was requested. Row-major; a null entry is an empty cell.

cellsSheetLayoutInfo.description: The view and print layout of one sheet, read as the objects the operations that set it name: set_sheet_view, set_tab_color, freeze_panes, resize_rows, resize_columns, group_rows, group_columns, set_autofilter, protect_sheet, set_print_area and set_page_setup, each with the fields of its operation. An object is omitted when the sheet does not have it.

sheet.description: The sheet's name.

sheetView.description: The on-screen view, as set_sheet_view sets it.

tabColor.description: The tab color, as set_tab_color sets it.

freezePanes.description: The frozen panes, as freeze_panes sets them.

rowHeights.description: Runs of adjacent rows of one height set apart from the content, as resize_rows sets them.

columnWidths.description: Runs of adjacent columns of one width other than the sheet's standard width, as resize_columns sets them.

rowGroups.description: Row outline groups, outer levels first, each a run of rows at its level or deeper.

columnGroups.description: Column outline groups, outer levels first, each a run of columns at its level or deeper.

autofilter.description: The sheet's AutoFilter, as set_autofilter sets it.

protection.description: The sheet's protection, as protect_sheet sets it; omitted when the sheet is not protected.

printArea.description: The print area and print titles, as set_print_area sets them.

pageSetup.description: The page setup, as set_page_setup sets it.

allow.description: The actions users may still perform, in the order protect_sheet lists them.

headings.description: Whether the row numbers and column letters show.

sheet.description: Sheet the sparklines are drawn on.

kind.description: The sparkline type: an add_sparkline kind, or the lower-case engine name of one outside that vocabulary.

color.description: The series color; omitted when the group has none.

dataRange.description: The data the group plots, one range when the sparklines' data fill it, otherwise each sparkline's data, comma-separated; it names the sheet only when that is not the group's own.

at.description: The cells the sparklines are drawn in: one range when they fill it, otherwise each cell, comma-separated, such as H2,H4,H5 after a row was inserted inside the group.

cellsTableInfo.description: A table (list object) in a workbook.

sheet.description: Sheet the table is on.

range.description: A1 range the table covers, e.g. A1:D20.

tableStyle.description: The table style, such as TableStyleMedium2; omitted when the table has none.

totalsRow.description: Whether the table shows a totals row.

cellsValidationInfo.description: A data validation in a workbook.

sheet.description: Sheet the validation is on.

range.description: The A1 range the validation applies to; several areas of one validation are comma-separated.

kind.description: The validation kind: a set_validation kind such as list or whole-number, or the lower-kebab engine name of a kind outside that vocabulary, such as any-value.

operator.description: The comparison of a kind that compares; omitted for list and custom.

value1.description: The first bound (the lower bound for between), or the formula of a custom validation; a number reads without the leading = Excel stores. Omitted for a list.

value2.description: The upper bound for between and not-between, read as value1 is.

listItems.description: The dropdown items of a list given as items.

listSource.description: The range a list reads its items from.

inputMessage.description: The prompt shown when a validated cell is selected; omitted when none.

errorMessage.description: The message shown when a value is rejected; omitted when none.

allowBlank.description: Whether a validated cell may be left blank.

name.description: File name without directory, e.g. report.xlsx.

sheetCount.description: Total number of worksheets, including hidden ones.

hasMacros.description: true when the workbook contains VBA macros.

definedNameCount.description: Number of defined names in the workbook.

structureProtected.description: true when the workbook structure is protected: Excel then refuses to add, delete, rename, move or hide sheets. Edits are not held to it; see PROTECTION_NOT_ENFORCED.

structurePasswordProtected.description: true when removing the structure protection needs a password.

author.description: Document author from built-in properties; omitted when empty.

title.description: Document title from built-in properties; omitted when empty.

defaultFont.description: The workbook default font, as set_default_font sets it.

definedNames.description: Defined names; present only with --detail names.

formulaErrors.description: Cells whose formula evaluates to an error; present only with --detail errors.

fonts.description: Distinct font names used in the workbook; present only with --detail fonts.

tables.description: Tables (list objects); present only with --detail tables.

pivots.description: Pivot tables; present only with --detail pivots.

validations.description: Data validations; present only with --detail validation.

conditionalFormats.description: Conditional formats, one per rule; present only with --detail conditional-formats.

sparklines.description: Sparkline groups; present only with --detail sparklines.

comments.description: Cell comments (notes); present only with --detail comments.

layouts.description: The layout of every sheet, in workbook order; present only with --detail layout.

v2/cells/ops.description: The operation document of cells edit --ops. An operation's sheet defaults to the active sheet; rows are 1-based numbers, columns are letters, and cells and ranges use A1 notation on that sheet unless a field says it may name another sheet. Operations apply in order. Without --best-effort the batch is atomic: if any operation fails, no file is written. With --best-effort the operations that succeed are kept and saved, each one that fails is reported, and the command exits 8 when any failed; an invalid document or a failure inside the document engine still writes nothing. The bare array of operations is accepted as the document with only its ops. Each operation field's x-readBack says whether it is state the operation writes and where a read reports it: a read result's schema URI with a JSON Pointer to the property that reports the field, where a pointer ending in a dictionary's additionalProperties is the entry named after the field; unread for state no read reports yet; position for state a read reports by position rather than by name, such as cell values; not-state for a selector, a source or a parameter of the action.

ifMatch.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint the input must still have; the edit fails when it changed.

id.description: A correlation id echoed in the result; op-0001 style ids are assigned when omitted.

add_comment.description: Adds a note (comment) to a cell; on a cell that has one, the text is added to it as a new paragraph. set_comment replaces a comment's text.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: The cell to annotate, such as B2.

author.description: The comment author; the engine default when omitted.

add_conditional_format.description: Adds a conditional format over a range. Each rule kind needs its own fields: cell-value an operator and value1 (and value2 for between and not-between); color-scale minColor and maxColor; data-bar barColor; formula value1, to which a missing leading = is added; top-bottom rank, at most 100 with percent; icon-set iconSet. cell-value, duplicates, formula and top-bottom need a matchStyle; icon-set takes none.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to format, such as B2:B100, or several separated by commas, such as B2:B10,D2:D10, as a read reports a rule over several areas: one rule formats them all.

add_sparkline.description: Adds a sparkline group over a data block: one sparkline per data row (or column), each drawn in one cell of at. A group a read reports as lists, such as at D5,D7,D8 over dataRange B5:C5,B7:C7,B8:C8, is written back with the same lists.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

dataRange.description: The data to plot, such as B2:E10: one sparkline per row (or column) of it. It may name another sheet, such as Data!B2:E10, so sparklines on a dashboard sheet can plot a data sheet. A list separated by commas, such as B5:C5,B7:C7,B8:C8, gives each sparkline its own row or column of data, in the order of the cells of at.

at.description: The cells the sparklines are drawn in, one each: a single cell or a one-row or one-column strip, such as F2 or F2:F10, or a list of them separated by commas, such as D5,D7,D8. Over one data block, the cell count must match its row count (one per row) or column count (one per column); over a list of data ranges, its range count.

kind.description: winloss draws equal-height columns above or below the axis by sign.

color.description: The series color; the engine default when omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

clear_conditional_formats.description: Removes all conditional formatting that overlaps a range.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to clear conditional formatting from, or several separated by commas, such as B2:B10,D2:D10.

clear_print_area.description: Removes a sheet's print area and its print titles.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

clear_range.description: Clears the contents, the formatting or both of a range.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to clear, such as B2:D10.

what.description: What to clear: contents keeps the formatting, formats keeps the contents, all clears both and the sparklines drawn in the range.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

clear_validation.description: Removes all data validation whose area overlaps a range.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to clear validation from, such as B2:B100, or several separated by commas, such as B2:B10,D2:D10.

copy_range.description: Copies a range with its values, formulas and formatting to an anchor cell.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

from.description: The source range; it may name another sheet.

to.description: The destination anchor cell; it may name another sheet, such as Summary!A1.

define_name.description: Creates or replaces a workbook-scoped defined name (a named range).

refersTo.description: The sheet-qualified range the name refers to, such as Config!$B$2.

define_table.description: Defines a range as a native table with filtering, an optional table style and an optional totals row.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to convert, including its header row, such as A1:D20.

name.description: The table name, unique among the workbook's tables and defined names: a letter, '_' or '\' first, then letters, digits, '.', '_', '\' or '?'; never text that reads as a cell reference such as T1 or R1C1. Generated when omitted.

tableStyle.description: A built-in table style (TableStyleLight1-21, TableStyleMedium1-28, TableStyleDark1-11), such as TableStyleMedium2, or a custom table style the workbook defines.

totalsRow.description: Whether a totals row is added below the table.

delete_chart.description: Removes a chart from a sheet, identified by exactly one of index and name.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

index.description: The 1-based index of the chart on the sheet, as inspect --detail charts lists it.

delete_columns.description: Deletes columns starting at a column.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

at.description: The first column to delete, such as C.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: The cell whose comment is removed.

delete_duplicates.description: Removes duplicate rows from a range, comparing every column or the listed ones.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to de-duplicate, including any header row, such as A1:D100.

columns.description: The columns inside the range that define a duplicate; every column when omitted.

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row is a header that is kept.

delete_hyperlink.description: Removes the hyperlink covering a cell.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: A cell the hyperlink covers, such as B2.

delete_rows.description: Deletes rows starting at a row.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

delete_sheet.description: Deletes the sheet the operation's sheet field names.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

format_range.description: Formats a range. Only the style fields that are set change; the rest of the existing formatting is preserved. The style must set at least one field.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to format, such as B2:D10.

freeze_panes.description: Freezes the panes above and left of a cell: A2 freezes row 1, B2 row 1 and column A. unfreeze_panes removes frozen panes.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: The top-left cell of the scrolling pane; not A1, which freezes nothing.

group_columns.description: Groups a span of columns into an outline level.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

first.description: The first column of the group.

last.description: The last column of the group, not left of first; first when omitted.

collapsed.description: Whether the new group is collapsed.

group_rows.description: Groups a span of rows into an outline level.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

first.description: The first row of the group (1-based).

last.description: The last row of the group (1-based), not above first; first when omitted.

collapsed.description: Whether the new group is collapsed.

import_range.description: Copies a range from another workbook file into this one at an anchor cell. The source is any file the Cells loader opens, including CSV and TSV, and is only read; it may be the edited file itself, read as it is on disk before the edit. A reference in an imported formula to another sheet of the source points at the sheet of that name in this workbook, or becomes #REF! when this workbook has none. A reference to a third workbook keeps its link and is not read through it, so recalculation uses the values the link cached.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

path.description: The source workbook file, relative to the working directory.

from.description: The source range; it may name a source sheet, such as Sheet1!A1:D20, and otherwise lies on the source's first sheet.

to.description: The destination anchor cell; it may name another sheet, such as Summary!A1.

content.description: What is imported: values writes the cell values, with formulas replaced by their results, and the number formats; all also keeps the formulas as written and the formatting, as copy_range does.

sourcePasswordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the source's open password, for an encrypted source.

import_sheet.description: Copies a whole sheet from another workbook file into this one as a new sheet, with its values, formulas, formatting, merged cells, column widths, tables, charts, pivot tables, comments, hyperlinks, validation and conditional formatting. The source is only read and may be the edited file itself, read as it is on disk before the edit. A reference to another sheet of the source points at the sheet of that name in this workbook, or becomes #REF! when this workbook has none, and the defined names the sheet refers to come along. A source that defines a workbook-level name this workbook also defines differently is refused unless the name refers only to the imported sheet. A reference to a third workbook keeps its link and is not read through it, so recalculation uses the values the link cached.

sourceSheet.description: The source sheet to copy, in the source workbook; the source's first sheet when omitted.

path.description: The source workbook file, relative to the working directory.

name.description: The name of the new sheet, as Excel allows it (see CellsSheetNames); the source sheet's name when omitted. A name this workbook already uses is refused.

at.description: The 1-based position of the new sheet in the tab order, as inspect reports a sheet's position; appended when omitted, or when past the last sheet.

sourcePasswordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the source's open password, for an encrypted source.

insert_chart.description: Adds a native chart that plots a data range. A pie chart has no axes and rejects axisTitles; legend, axisTitles and dataLabels each set at least one field.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

dataRange.description: The data to plot, including headers, such as A1:C5. It may name another sheet, such as Data!A1:C5, so a chart on a dashboard sheet can plot a data sheet.

at.description: The range of at least two cells the chart is placed over, such as E2:L18.

seriesInRows.description: Whether series are plotted from rows rather than columns.

seriesColors.description: Series colors in series order; a pie's slices count as the series. Colors beyond the series count are ignored.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

at.description: The column to insert before, such as C.

insert_image.description: Inserts a picture from a file, anchored at a cell.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

path.description: The image file (png, jpeg, gif or bmp), relative to the working directory.

at.description: The top-left anchor cell, such as E2.

width.description: The width in points; the image's natural width when omitted.

height.description: The height in points; the image's natural height when omitted.

insert_pivot.description: Adds a pivot table that summarizes a source range. Its captions (value field names, the grand total, the row, column and value headers) follow captions, whose auto default changes only pivots with Han field names; a value field's label always wins. A label that repeats a source header or another value field's caption, ignoring case, is refused, as Excel refuses it.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

sourceRange.description: The source data including headers; it may name another sheet, such as Data!A1:D100.

at.description: The top-left cell of the pivot table.

name.description: The pivot table name; generated when omitted.

rows.description: The header names of the row fields.

columns.description: The header names of the column fields.

values.description: The value fields with their aggregation; two or more are columns, after the column fields, as in Excel.

captions.description: The caption language: en keeps the engine's English captions (Sum of X, Grand Total); zh writes Excel's Simplified Chinese ones (求和项:X, 总计, 行标签, 列标签, 值); auto is zh when a row, column or value field name contains a Han character, otherwise en.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

name.description: The name of the new sheet, as Excel allows it (see CellsSheetNames).

at.description: The 1-based position in the tab order, as inspect reports a sheet's position; appended when omitted, or when past the last sheet.

merge_cells.description: Merges a range into one cell.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to merge, such as A1:C1.

move_sheet.description: Moves the sheet the operation's sheet field names to a position in the tab order. Cross-sheet and 3-D references follow the new order as they would in Excel.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

to.description: The 1-based destination in the tab order, as inspect reports a sheet's position; a value past the last sheet moves it to the end.

protect_sheet.description: Protects a sheet against edits: every action is locked except the ones allowed.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the protection password.

allow.description: The actions users may still perform.

protect_workbook.description: Protects the workbook structure: adding, deleting, moving and hiding sheets.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the protection password.

refresh_pivot.description: Recalculates pivot tables so they reflect changed source data; pivots do not refresh on their own.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

name.description: The pivot table name; every pivot table on the sheet when omitted.

rename_sheet.description: Renames the sheet the operation's sheet field names.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

name.description: The new name, as Excel allows it (see CellsSheetNames).

resize_columns.description: Sets the width of a span of columns, or auto-fits them when widthChars is omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

last.description: The last column, not left of first; first when omitted.

widthChars.description: The width in characters of the default font's digit 0; omitted auto-fits.

resize_rows.description: Sets the height of a span of rows, or auto-fits them when height is omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

last.description: The 1-based last row, not above first; first when omitted.

height.description: The height in points; omitted auto-fits.

set_active_sheet.description: Makes the visible sheet the operation's sheet field names the active sheet. The choice survives saving and is the initial tab of the HTML preview.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

set_autofilter.description: Sets the sheet's AutoFilter over a range; clear_autofilter removes it.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to filter, including its header row, such as A1:D20.

set_borders.description: Draws borders on a range, every named edge with the same line style and color; the rest of the cells' formatting is preserved. A single cell has no inner lines, so it needs an outer edge.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to border, such as B2:D10.

edges.description: The edges to draw: outline (the four outer edges), inside (the inner grid lines), single edges, horizontal and vertical inner lines, or all (the full grid).

set_chart.description: Updates an existing chart, identified by exactly one of index and name, with at least one of title, dataRange, kind, legend, axisTitles, seriesColors and dataLabels. seriesInRows applies only together with dataRange; legend, axisTitles and dataLabels each set at least one field.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

index.description: The 1-based index of the chart on the sheet, as inspect --detail charts lists it.

dataRange.description: The new data to plot, including headers; it may name another sheet, such as Data!A1:C5.

seriesInRows.description: Whether series are plotted from rows rather than columns.

seriesColors.description: Series colors in series order; a pie's slices count as the series. Colors beyond the series count are ignored.

set_comment.description: Replaces the text of a cell's comment.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

author.description: The new author; unchanged when omitted.

set_default_font.description: Sets the workbook default font. It changes the Normal style every unstyled cell derives its font from and the unit column widths are measured in, so set it first in a new workbook, before content and column widths. Cells with an explicit font keep it.

font.description: The font family name, such as Calibri; surrounding spaces are removed.

fontSize.description: The font size in points; unchanged when omitted.

set_formula.description: Sets a formula on every cell of a range with Excel fill semantics: relative references shift per cell, absolute ($) references stay. Every cell evaluates like Excel 365: array arithmetic inside a function, such as =MAX(B2*$F$2:$F$8-$G$2:$G$8), covers the whole ranges, and a formula set on a single cell whose result is an array, such as FILTER or UNIQUE, spills into the cells beside and below it, or shows #SPILL! when they are not empty.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to fill, such as C2:C100.

formula.description: The formula of the range's top-left cell in A1 notation, such as =SUM(B2:B10).

set_hyperlink.description: Sets the hyperlink of one cell, an external URL or an internal target, replacing a link that covered it.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: The cell to link, such as B2.

url.description: An external URL, such as https://example.com.

target.description: An internal target, such as Summary!A1.

display.description: The text shown in the cell; the URL or target when omitted.

set_page_setup.description: Sets the page layout for printing and PDF export: at least one field, and margins set at least one side. Only the fields present are applied; the rest of the page setup is preserved.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

pageSize.description: The paper size: a preset, turned by the orientation, or a width and height in points whose longer side is the width in landscape and the height in portrait, as a read reports it.

fitToWidth.description: The number of pages the printout fits across; 0 is automatic.

fitToHeight.description: The number of pages the printout fits down; 0 is automatic.

scalePercent.description: The zoom percentage; ignored when the printout fits to pages.

headerMargin.description: The distance in points from the top of the page to the header.

footerMargin.description: The distance in points from the bottom of the page to the footer.

headerCenter.description: The center header text, with Excel codes such as &P (page) and &N (pages).

footerCenter.description: The center footer text, with Excel codes such as &P and &N.

set_print_area.description: Sets the print area of a sheet and the rows and columns repeated on every printed page; titles omitted are removed. clear_print_area removes all three.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The print area, such as A1:H50, or several areas separated by commas, such as A1:B5,D1:E5, each printed on pages of its own.

titleRows.description: The rows repeated on every printed page, such as 1:2 or 1.

titleColumns.description: The columns repeated on every printed page, such as A:B or A.

set_sheet_view.description: Changes a sheet's on-screen view: at least one of gridlines, zoomPercent and headings. These are view settings for Excel and the live preview, not for the printed page or rendered images; draw borders (set_borders) when a grid must appear in renders.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

gridlines.description: Whether the on-screen gridlines show; unchanged when omitted.

zoomPercent.description: The zoom percentage; unchanged when omitted.

headings.description: Whether the row numbers and column letters show; unchanged when omitted.

set_sheet_visibility.description: Hides or shows the sheet the operation's sheet field names.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

set_tab_color.description: Sets a sheet's tab color; clear_tab_color removes it.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

set_validation.description: Applies data validation, a dropdown list or an input constraint, to a range, replacing the validation the range had. A list takes exactly one of listItems and listSource; custom takes its formula in value1; the other kinds take an operator and value1, and value2 too for between and not-between.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to validate, such as B2:B100, or several separated by commas, such as B2:B10,D2:D10, as a read reports a validation over several areas: one validation covers them all.

value1.description: The first bound (the lower bound for between), or the formula of a custom validation.

value2.description: The upper bound for between and not-between.

listItems.description: The dropdown items of a list. No item contains a comma or a double quote, and joined with commas they stay within Excel's 255 characters; use listSource for longer lists.

listSource.description: The range a list reads its items from, such as Lists!A1:A20.

inputMessage.description: The prompt shown when a validated cell is selected.

errorMessage.description: The message shown when a value is rejected.

allowBlank.description: Whether a validated cell may be left blank.

set_values.description: Writes a row-major matrix of values: strings, numbers, Booleans, or null to clear a cell. Every row has the same number of cells, at least one. A single-cell range is the top-left anchor; a larger range must match the matrix dimensions exactly.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The anchor cell or the exact target range, such as B2 or B2:D4.

sort_range.description: Sorts a range in place by one or more of its columns.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to sort, such as A2:D100.

by.description: The sort keys, primary first; each column lies inside the range.

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row is a header that stays in place.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

ungroup_columns.description: Removes one outline level from a span of columns.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

first.description: The first column of the span.

last.description: The last column of the span, not left of first; first when omitted.

ungroup_rows.description: Removes one outline level from a span of rows.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

first.description: The first row of the span (1-based).

last.description: The last row of the span (1-based), not above first; first when omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The merged range to split, such as A1:C1.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the current password of a password-protected sheet.
The environment variable that holds the current password of a password-protected workbook.

cell.description: One A1 cell on the operation's sheet, such as B2; name another sheet with the operation's sheet field.

cellsBorderData.description: The line on one side of a cell.

lineStyle.description: The line style; a read reports a dash pattern outside the vocabulary, such as dash-dot, as dashed.

cellsChartAxisTitles.description: The axis titles of a chart; only the fields present are applied. Pie charts have no axes.

category.description: The title of the category (X) axis.

value.description: The title of the value (Y) axis.

cellsChartDataLabels.description: The data labels of a chart's series; only the fields present are applied.

visible.description: Whether each point's value shows next to it.

numberFormat.description: The number format code of the labels, such as #,##0.

cellsChartLegend.description: The legend of a chart; only the fields present are applied. There is no none position: hide the legend with visible false.

position.description: The side of the chart the legend sits on.

cellsConditionalRule.description: A conditional-formatting rule; the fields it uses depend on its kind.

kind.description: cell-value compares values; color-scale and data-bar shade by value; duplicates marks repeated values; formula formats where a formula is true, anchored at the range's top-left cell and shifted per cell; top-bottom marks the top or bottom N or N percent; icon-set draws icons with automatic thresholds.

operator.description: The comparison of a cell-value rule.

value1.description: The comparison value of a cell-value rule (the lower bound for between): a number, text as it is (Done) or quoted as in Excel ("Done"), or a formula after = (=$F$1). For a formula rule, the formula, which anchors at the range's top-left cell and shifts per cell ($ parts stay fixed).

value2.description: The upper bound of a between or not-between cell-value rule, written as value1 is.

minColor.description: The low-end color of a color-scale.

midColor.description: The middle color of a 3-point color-scale; a 2-point scale omits it.

maxColor.description: The high-end color of a color-scale.

barColor.description: The bar color of a data-bar.

rank.description: The N of a top-bottom rule: the top or bottom N values, or N percent.

percent.description: Whether a top-bottom rank is a percentage of the range.

fromBottom.description: Whether a top-bottom rule marks the bottom rather than the top.

iconSet.description: The icons of an icon-set rule.

cellsConditionalStyle.description: The differential style a conditional format gives matching cells. Excel applies only font emphasis, colors and the number format there; format_range sets fonts, sizes, alignment, wrapping and indents. It sets at least one field.

underline.description: Whether the text has a single underline.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

numberFormat.description: The number format code, such as 0.0%.

cellsMargins.description: Page margins in points (72 per inch); only the sides present are applied, and at least one is set. A read reports every side.

cellsPivotValueField.description: One aggregated value field of a pivot table.

field.description: The header name of the source column.

function.description: The aggregation of the field's values.

numberFormat.description: The number format code of the field, such as #,##0.

label.description: The caption of the value field, such as Net sales; derived from the function and field when omitted.

cellsSortKey.description: One sort key of a sort_range operation.

cellsStyleData.description: Cell formatting. A read reports the fields a cell's style sets; an edit changes only the fields it sets and preserves the rest, and must set at least one.

fontSize.description: The font size in points; fractional sizes such as 10.5 are kept.

numberFormat.description: The number format code, such as 0.0%.

alignment.description: The horizontal alignment of the text.

verticalAlignment.description: The vertical alignment of the text.

wrap.description: Whether text wraps within the cell.

underline.description: Whether the text has a single underline.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

indent.description: The indent level; 0 removes the indent.

locked.description: Whether Excel keeps the cell read-only once its sheet is protected. Every cell is locked unless set false, as for the input cells of a protected form; a read reports only false.

borders.description: The cell's border lines, one per side that has one, in the order top, bottom, left, right. An edit draws each side it lists and leaves the other sides as they are; set_borders draws the outline and inner lines of a whole range.

column.description: Column letters from A to XFD, such as B or AA.

pageSizeInput.description: The size of a page in points (72 per inch) as an operation sets it: a preset, in portrait, or both the width and the height. A read reports it as a page size under the same names, with the preset the dimensions match, and writes back as it reads: given with the width and height, the preset must be the paper they measure in either orientation, and the width and height apply.

preset.description: The preset, in portrait; with the width and height, the paper they measure.

width.description: The page width in points, given with the height.

height.description: The page height in points, given with the width.

range.description: An A1 cell or range on the operation's sheet, such as B2 or B2:D10; name another sheet with the operation's sheet field. Whole rows and columns are not ranges.

reference.description: An A1 cell or range on the operation's sheet, such as A1:C10, or on another sheet, such as Data!A1:C10 or 'My Sheet'!A1:C10.

webLink.description: An absolute http://, https:// or mailto: URL.

v2/cells/read-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells read: a budgeted projection of one sheet's cell data. The envelope's window counts cells: how many the read returned, how many the read covers, and for a read over the cell budget the ready-to-run command that returns the next page. The file on disk remains the primary artifact — this JSON is a view of it, never a round-trip format.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

content.description: What each cell carries, as --content chose it.

sheet.description: Projection of the requested sheet.

styles.description: Style pool referenced by styleId in cells; present only for the styles and full contents. Pooling styles keeps repeated formatting from bloating the payload.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

cellsBorderData.description: The line on one side of a cell.

lineStyle.description: The line style; a read reports a dash pattern outside the vocabulary, such as dash-dot, as dashed.

cellsCellData.description: One cell in a projection. Empty cells are {"t":"empty"}.

v.description: The cell value: string, number, boolean, an ISO 8601 string for date/time values, the error literal (e.g. #DIV/0!) for error cells, or omitted for empty cells.

f.description: Formula in A1 notation (with leading =); only with formulas content.

styleId.description: Key into the style pool; only with styles content.

cellsSheetProjection.description: Budgeted cell data of one sheet.

name.description: Sheet name, exactly as shown in Excel.

position.description: 1-based position in the tab order, as insert_sheet and move_sheet take it.

usedRange.description: A1 range covering all data on the sheet; omitted when empty.

range.description: A1 range returned in cells; omitted when no cells were returned, as for an empty sheet or a default read over the cell budget.

cells.description: Row-major cell matrix covering exactly range. Omitted when the sheet is empty or a default read over the cell budget returned only a summary.

cellsStyleData.description: Cell formatting. A read reports the fields a cell's style sets; an edit changes only the fields it sets and preserves the rest, and must set at least one.

fontSize.description: The font size in points; fractional sizes such as 10.5 are kept.

numberFormat.description: The number format code, such as 0.0%.

alignment.description: The horizontal alignment of the text.

verticalAlignment.description: The vertical alignment of the text.

wrap.description: Whether text wraps within the cell.

underline.description: Whether the text has a single underline.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

indent.description: The indent level; 0 removes the indent.

locked.description: Whether Excel keeps the cell read-only once its sheet is protected. Every cell is locked unless set false, as for the input cells of a protected form; a read reports only false.

borders.description: The cell's border lines, one per side that has one, in the order top, bottom, left, right. An edit draws each side it lists and leaves the other sides as they are; set_borders draws the outline and inner lines of a whole range.

v2/cells/render-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells render: visual images of sheets (or a range of one), the primary way for an agent to "look at" a spreadsheet.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The image of each rendered sheet, in workbook order: one file for one sheet, the --out path itself, or <stem>.<sheet>.<ext> per sheet.

range.description: A1 range that was rendered; omitted when whole sheets were rendered.

dpi.description: Raster resolution in dots per inch; omitted for vector output.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

cellsSheetOutput.description: The image of one rendered sheet.

sheet.description: Name of the rendered sheet.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 identity of the published file.

v2/cells/search-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells search: one window of cell hits for a pattern. Hits are ordered by sheet then row-major, so output is deterministic; the envelope's window counts the returned hits and, when more match, carries the command that returns the next ones.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

pattern.description: The pattern that was searched for (echoed back).

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet the cell is on.

text.description: Display value of the cell (truncated for long text).

formula.description: Formula, when the cell has one.
